analysis.originalPrompt: [캐릭터 외형 프롬프트/ + GPT가 샘플로 참고할 외형 이미지 한 장 첨부], photorealistic real-person interpretation, official passport ID photo, neat and presentable appearance, straight-on camera, centered symmetrical composition, neutral expression, looking directly at camera, tidy hair, clean simple outfit, plain light-gray studio background, soft even ID-photo lighting, head-and-shoulders framing, 2x2 grid of four identical ID photos on one printed photo sheet, realistic physical photo print, subtle pixel-level blur, slight compression artifacts and natural camera noise, authentic consumer photo-lab quality, highly realistic, not overly polished, not AI-looking / 이대로 이미지 출력.

translations.zh: [角色外形提示词 / + 附带一张供GPT参考外形的样本图]，逼真真人诠释，正式护照证件照，整洁大方的容貌，正对镜头，居中对称构图，中性表情，直视镜头，整洁发型，干净简约服装，纯色浅灰摄影棚背景，柔和均匀证件照光线，齐胸齐肩构图，单张打印相纸上呈2x2排列的四张相同证件照，逼真实体冲印照片，轻微像素级模糊，微弱压缩杂色与自然相机噪点，地道民用照相馆质感，高度真实，不过度修饰，无AI质感 / 按此生成图像。
translations.en: [Character appearance prompt / + attach 1 reference image for GPT], photorealistic real-person interpretation, official passport ID photo, neat and presentable appearance, straight-on camera, centered symmetrical composition, neutral expression, looking directly at camera, tidy hair, clean simple outfit, plain light-gray studio background, soft even ID-photo lighting, head-and-shoulders framing, 2x2 grid of four identical ID photos on one printed photo sheet, realistic physical photo print, subtle pixel-level blur, slight compression artifacts and natural camera noise, authentic consumer photo-lab quality, highly realistic, not overly polished, not AI-looking / output image as is.
